description:
Parent: zaq-ic9.14. Read the parent contract and inherited policies before work. This task stays blocked until its recorded prerequisite is complete.

Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
Audit GetDocument, tools/registry.ex, Record alias/provenance helpers, Factory tool interception, StreamEvents, Executor, Pipeline and the pinned Jido runtime. Read module docs and existing tests. Prove how trusted request ID/incarnation reaches an Action, where effects apply, and how committed selection reaches the stream without sensitive persistence. Define deterministic ordering/replay rules and freeze/cleanup semantics. Record exact file/test scope and complete downstream Action reuse assessments. Resolve unsupported mechanisms before implementation.

Tests to add before implementation:
Characterization tests for actual trusted context/effect flow and alias round trip; inspect privacy and lifecycle tests. Do not claim mocked success proves Jido integration.

Branches/paths validated:
Cover success, invalid input/authorization, lifecycle and propagation paths relevant to this step; preserve the parent's add/remove/replace, atomicity, request isolation and privacy invariants.

Mocking plan:
Keep internal ZAQ and Jido boundaries real where supported; mock only external model/provider/network edges. No shared global test configuration. Discovery must identify any hard constraint before test-only abstractions are added.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content:
Record evidence, decisions and validation in this issue. Update affected module docs and docs/services/agent.md with implementation; final documentation consistency is checked by the validation task. Do not describe proposed behavior as shipped.

Action reuse assessment:
Discovery only; no new executable operation. Reuse assessment is not applicable to this audit itself. Audit candidate operations and choose reuse/extend/new/local-only for every downstream step; identify missing prerequisites.

Gates:
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md and docs/testing-approach.md. Discovery must resolve unknown contracts and finalize this step before coding. Existing test behavior changes require explicit human approval. No commit/push/merge implied.

comments.text: Characterization passed: real Factory/Jido request_effect_characterization_test and existing materialization_alias_integration_test (2 passed). Native context contains exact request.id/run_id, agent module, state snapshot and Factory execution_root; emitted SetPath reaches owning Agent state and raw tool_completed stream. Pinned runner executes tools concurrently but emits completions in declaration order. Generic effects apply after trace/thread/stream projection, so selection effects must be consumed and removed in Factory before native worker-event processing. Checkpoints carry signed full model context and must be stripped from projected selection-bearing runs. Canonical selection will live in Jido Agent state, initialized using super-generated native request id plus runtime PID; no global catalog. Action emits a private SetPath command, Factory binds native invocation id in after_tool_call and folds commands serially before projections. Seen invocation IDs fence replay; native event seq/request/incarnation fence stale events. Complete freezes and sends a private final snapshot only to request stream; failure/cancel discards. New request resets. StreamEvents returns snapshot only on successful terminal. Source authorization reuses Record.Authorization.can?/3; schema/provenance/alias conversion reuse Record.zoi_type/from_map and OpaqueAliases. GetDocument unchanged; Channels retains final materialization authorization. Exact downstream scope: new tools/messages/attach_documents.ex and attachment_selection.ex; extend Factory, StreamEvents, Registry, Executor, Pipeline; focused Action/property/runtime/privacy/result tests and Agent service docs. No source deletion, no materialization or delivery in selection.

Validation: mix q passed. Discovery resolved native hooks (on_before_cmd/on_after_cmd and ToolInterceptor) without dependency changes. Checkpoint token payload includes model tool context, so selection-enabled requests must redact tokens before native trace storage. Preserve model-private context needed for aliases, redact selection tool arguments/results from parent stream/thread projections. Reuse scope: .2 new validated Action only, .3 local-only AttachmentSelection reducer and Factory lifecycle hooks (runtime ownership, not another business operation), .4 extend existing result maps and Outgoing; .5 docs/verification not applicable to Action reuse. Real context/effect and existing alias round-trip characterizations are passing. Application changes remain uncommitted per explicit user override.

Reopened: downstream authorization inspection disproved the initial discovery-complete assessment. Concrete temporary proof /tmp/zaq_attachment_provenance_probe_test.exs passes against current source: original Record denies attacker; editing only permissions[0].attributes.principal.identifier to attacker email preserves original provenance_ref, Provenance.verify returns ok, and Record.Authorization.can? returns true. Provenance.principal/1 signs flat principal_type/key while Authorization.principal/1 prioritizes nested principal.channel/identifier (and nested type/key). This violates forged-Record rejection required by attach_documents. Source owners: lib/zaq/contracts/record/provenance.ex and authorization.ex. Global provenance contract affects existing consumers outside Agent. Escalating security-contract change per WORKFLOW_AGENT before implementing it; .2 remains open and blocked. Proposed fix: sign the effective nested principal using the same precedence as Authorization, preserve flat-field behavior, add forgery regression/property coverage. Existing nested-principal tokens would need refetch/reissuance; never allow fallback verification that accepts an altered principal. No commits, pushes, sync or precommit.
